commit_message: Document AI-native authoring parity and MCP lifecycle
pr_title: GameEngine: define AI-native authoring parity and MCP lifecycle
pr_body:
## Summary

- add ADR 0121 defining MCP as the standard structured AI authoring interface for an active Editor project
- resolve the MCP transport/process lifecycle with an Editor-owned project-scoped loopback endpoint and single-call transaction boundary
- define the staged parity plan for Scene/schema, assets/prefabs, graph/UI, typed documents, and CI parity guardrails
- update the canonical authoring specification and ADR index

## Validation

Documentation-only change; expect GameEngine Windows Validation `docs` mode.

## Notes

No persisted project schema, Stable ID, existing CLI output, or existing MCP tool name is changed by this ADR.
